 BananaBro, Boat Noodle founder Tony Lim dies
 02-Nov-2026, 12:53 02 Nov 2026, 12:53 FMT Reporters Share There are currently 49 Boat Noodle outlets and more than 40 BananaBro branches across the country.
 Tony Lim’s death was announced today on the social media pages of both eateries. (Banana Bro pic) 
 PETALING JAYA : Tony Lim, the food and beverage entrepreneur who founded the BananaBro and Boat Noodle restaurants, has died. 
 His death was announced today on the social media pages of both eateries. His age and cause of death were not disclosed.
 In an Instagram post, BananaBro said Lim wanted to introduce banana leaf rice to the world, giving rise to the restaurant chain.
 “Tony gave more than just his vision. He gave his heart to the people and the journey he believed in. Though he is no longer with us, his dream lives on in every banana leaf we serve and every life he has touched.
 “Thank you, Tony. Your passion inspired us, your generosity touched us and your legacy will live on,” it said.
 Boat Noodle, meanwhile, said Lim was a dreamer and mentor who built the brand while expressing genuine belief in the people who worked under him.
 “He taught us to never give up, to believe in ourselves, and most importantly, to grow together. These were never just words to Tony. They were something he lived by.
 “Tony, thank you for believing in us, for everything you have taught us, and for giving us something so meaningful to carry forward,” it said in a Facebook post.
 There are currently 49 Boat Noodle outlets and more than 40 BananaBro branches across the country.
